Your routines, progress, history and rem: Your routines, progress, history and reminder settings are stored on your device. When iCloud is available, Routine can sync them through Apple’s CloudKit using your Apple account. Apple’s iCloud and backup settings govern those services. Routine has no separate account or synchronization server.
Reminders use local notifications with y: Reminders use local notifications with your permission. Face ID, Touch ID and device passcode authentication are handled by the operating system. Routine does not receive biometric templates. You can manage permissions in system settings.
Routine includes no developer analytics,: Routine includes no developer analytics, advertising trackers or third-party crash reporting. The app and operating system may produce local diagnostic logs.

On iPhone and iPad, deleting the app nor: On iPhone and iPad, deleting the app normally removes app-local data. On Mac, removing the app can leave its local app-container and shared App Group data behind. CloudKit data and iCloud backups may remain under your Apple account and need separate management through Apple’s iCloud storage settings. Deleting the app does not guarantee deletion of every copy.
